YHWH (the LORD): the name of Israel's God
items.bdb:
Jehovah = "the existing One"
1) the proper name of the one true God
1a) unpronounced except with the vowel pointings of a.do.na (אֲדֹנָי "Lord" H0136)

items.gloss: Israel: Jacob's other name; the people descended from him; (later) the northern kingdom
David: Jesse's son, second king of Israel
Moses: leader of Israel out of Egypt
Saul: first king of Israel, a Benjaminite

items.bdb:
§ Egypt = "land of the Copts"
 a country at the northeastern section of Africa, adjacent to Palestine, and through which the Nile flows
Egyptians = "double straits"

items.gloss: Judah: Jacob's son; his tribe and territory; (later) the southern kingdom
Philistine(s): people of the southern coastal plain, Israel's enemies
items.bdb:
Philistine = "immigrants"
 an inhabitant of Philistia; descendants of Mizraim who immigrated from Caphtor (Crete?) to the western seacoast of Canaan
Another spelling of pe.le.shet (פְּלֶ֫שֶׁת "Philistia" H6429)

items.gloss: Pharaoh: title of the king of Egypt
items.bdb:
A man of the Egyptians living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.3.10
Also named: Pharaō (Φαραώ "Pharaoh" G5328I)
 § Pharaoh = "great house"
 the common title of the king of Egypt

items.gloss: Aaron: Moses' brother, the first high priest
